high_level_description: The image appears to be a slide from a presentation titled "We Need Human-Level AI for Intelligent Assistant." The slide is attributed to Y. LeCun, as indicated in the top right corner. The background of the slide features a colorful abstract design with shades of blue, yellow, and red. The slide contains several bullet points discussing the need for human-level artificial intelligence (AI) in the context of intelligent assistants: In the near future, all of our interactions with the digital world will be mediated by AI assistants.
